leads.text:
I found out my husband's "annual fishing trip with the guys" was actually a week at a fertility clinic, donating sperm to a woman neither of us had ever met in person.

He'd gone every June for nine years. Same lake, he said, same four friends, same cabin with spotty cell service. I never questioned it because nothing about it ever seemed off.

Then an envelope arrived at our house, forwarded from an old P.O. box he apparently still used. A clinic's letterhead. A payment confirmation. 
A thank-you note from a recipient family, addressed directly to him, mentioning "your third successful donation this year."

Third. As in, not his first year doing this. Not even close.
